title: Rajya Sabha Clears ₹54,067 Crore Appropriation Bill 2026 under Article 114
summary: Provides constitutional authorization for parliamentary approval of excess expenditure beyond original budget grants.

blocks.content: Provides constitutional authorization for parliamentary approval of excess expenditure beyond original budget grants.

items: Constitutional Mandate: Article 114 mandates parliamentary approval before withdrawing funds from Consolidated Fund of India (CFI).
